instruction: From ANSYS, Abaqus, and AutoCAD, select an appropriate tool for the task. In this image, launch Abaqus CAE or AutoCAD 2024 from their desktop shortcuts; ANSYS MAPDL is available at `C:\Program Files\ANSYS Inc\v261\ansys\bin\winx64\ANSYS261.exe`. Use the selected tool to build and solve a 3D transient thermal conduction model. Physical problem: One-dimensional transient heat conduction in a semi-infinite-like steel block. Coordinate system and geometry: - Use the global Cartesian coordinate system. - Heat conduction is along the X direction. - The long direction of the block is X. - The block occupies: - 0 <= X <= 50 mm - 0 <= Y <= 20 mm - 0 <= Z <= 20 mm - The left end face is the face at X = 0. - The other end face is the face at X = 50 mm. - The model should behave as a one-dimensional conduction problem along X. Model parameters: - Block size: 50 mm x 20 mm x 20 mm - Material: steel - Use a unit-consistent mm-s-J-kg-degrees C system: - Thermal conductivity: 0.05 W/(mm degrees C), equivalent to 50 W/(m K) - Specific heat: 460 J/(kg degrees C) - Density: 7.85e-6 kg/mm^3, equivalent to 7850 kg/m^3 - Element type: appropriate three-dimensional thermal solid element formulation - Mesh: global element size 2 mm - The mesh should contain nodes at X = 4 mm and X = 6 mm. A regular 2 mm mesh along X satisfies this requirement. Boundary and initial conditions: - Initial temperature of the whole model: 20 degrees C - Left end face at X = 0: prescribed temperature 100 degrees C - All other external surfaces, including X = 50 mm, Y = 0, Y = 20 mm, Z = 0, and Z = 20 mm, are adiabatic. Analysis type: - Transient thermal analysis - Total analysis time: 10 s - Initial time step: 0.1 s - Save the final result at t = 10 s. Deliverables: save the native model artifact and the native solver result artifact into `C:\Users\user\Desktop\result`. Save only the files from the selected tool. Software launch locations: Abaqus/CAE: `C:\Users\user\Desktop\Abaqus CAE.lnk`; ANSYS: multiple ANSYS launch shortcuts are available under `C:\Users\Public\Desktop`; choose the most suitable ANSYS shortcut for the task; AutoCAD 2024: `C:\Users\Public\Desktop\AutoCAD 2024.lnk`.
